div.head: VI Atr 42.3
div.ab: and þæt hi Godes circan æghwar georne griðian ⁊ friðian ⁊ mid leohte ⁊ lacum gelome hig gegretan, ⁊ híg silfe þar georne gebiddan.
⁊ þæt hy Godes cyrican æghwar georne griðian ⁊ friþian ⁊ mid leohte ⁊ lacum hi gelome gegretan ⁊ hy sylfe þær georne to Christe gebiddan.
And þæt hy Godes cyrican æghwar georne griðian and friþian, and mid leohte and lacum hi gelome gegretan, and hy sylfe þær georne to Christe gebiddan.

and that they should diligently maintain the security and sanctity of the churches of God everywhere, and frequently visit them with candles and offerings, and themselves there earnestly pray to Christ.
And they are to everywhere diligently preserve and protect God’s churches, and to visit them frequently with candles and offerings, and there themselves pray fervently to Christ.
und dass sie überall Gottes Kirchen gern mit Schutzgewalt und Friedensrecht umgeben und sie oft mit Lichtkerzen und Gaben besuchen und dort selbst eifrig zu Christus beten.
and that they eagerly protect and keep the peace of God's churches everywhere, and often visit them with candles and offerings, and there themselves pray eagerly (to Christ, K).
